labeling.method: Hand-labelled from the fixture text only, before running the pipeline. Each label cites the fixture line(s) it rests on (cat -n numbering). Task and objection labels are keyword groups: every group must be matched by at least one of its alternatives, case-insensitive, so a correct answer in English or in the conversation's language both count.
labeling.stageRule: Highest stage whose entry criterion the conversation itself shows: Lead = inquiry only; Qualified = need plus budget or timeline confirmed; Meeting/Demo = a meeting or demo booked; Proposal = a written quote/proposal actually sent; Negotiation = buyer negotiating terms of a sent proposal. A price mentioned in chat with the formal offer still to be sent is not Proposal.
